items.html: *(33) Now, these Nekudim expanded from the Tabura of AK to the end of his feet, in the order of ZON that clothes AA — except that there ZON clothes AA on all its sides and around it, whereas here their main illumination is only through the anterior of AK. Yet a little illumination of these Nekudim does expand, both in the discernment of their lights and in the discernment of their vessels, and they clothe this AK on all its sides, in the manner we explained above regarding AHP; but their main illumination is through the anterior.
